note: Hex colors in the sales-page draft and the iPhone shell that are not design tokens. Checked by scripts/check-landing-tokens.js; run in npm run check:tokens.

exceptions.reason: the landing page's soft body-text tone (--sage); the nearest token, sage, is #C3CBB1, a visibly different shade
exceptions.retireWhen: the landing text tones are added to design/tokens.json or moved to the app's sage

exceptions.reason: the landing page's muted caption tone (--lichen); the token lichen is #C8D0B6, lighter
exceptions.retireWhen: the landing text tones are added to design/tokens.json or moved to the app's lichen

exceptions.reason: the landing page's hairline color (--line), between the tokens moss and canopy
exceptions.retireWhen: a hairline token is added to design/tokens.json

exceptions.reason: text in the header pill, a one-off off-white
exceptions.retireWhen: the pill uses the cream token

exceptions.reason: placeholder text in the waitlist field, a one-off gray-green
exceptions.retireWhen: the field uses a token for placeholders

exceptions.reason: the phone-frame screenshots' black bezel, darker than any token
exceptions.retireWhen: a bezel token is added or the frame moves to the app's phone-frame tokens

exceptions.reason: the draft banner's background. It is a warning for the owner and disappears when nothing is missing
exceptions.retireWhen: the draft banner is removed from the shipped page

exceptions.reason: the draft banner's border, same reason
exceptions.retireWhen: the draft banner is removed from the shipped page

exceptions.reason: the draft banner's text, same reason
exceptions.retireWhen: the draft banner is removed from the shipped page

exceptions.reason: the forest token (#202D14) for the app background and the Android icon background; app.json cannot import theme.generated.js
exceptions.retireWhen: app.json becomes app.config.js and reads the color from theme.generated.js
